title: Cherish the Lord by relying on mercy
summary: The soul loves from dependence, admitting its mistakes like a child before Father and Mother. Mercy makes truth-telling safer than self-defense.
takeaway: Come as the mistaken child, not the worthy performer.
lifeApplication: When shame makes you perform goodness, pray from the child-place instead. Tell the truth without ornament and let mercy receive you there.

source.shortMeaning: The beloved is cherished through reliance on mercy and childlike honesty about failure.
source.lifeApplication: When failure makes you hide, come to the Lord as a child who can still tell the truth.

evidence.coreClaim: The beloved is cherished through reliance on mercy and childlike honesty about failure.
evidence.turn: The lines turn failure away from self-protection and toward the One who is both Father and Mother.
evidence.practicalImplication: When shame makes you perform goodness, pray from the child-place instead. Tell the truth without ornament and let mercy receive you there.
